usageNotes: Use this to define a new SDN fabric — the routing/overlay protocol backbone (OpenFabric, OSPF, WireGuard, or BGP) that interconnects Proxmox cluster nodes. Requires the SDN.Allocate privilege on /sdn/fabrics. After creating a fabric, you must apply the SDN configuration (PUT /cluster/sdn) for changes to take effect on nodes.

examples.summary: Create a WireGuard fabric with a persistent keepalive and an IPv4 node prefix

tips: The 'id' field must be 2–8 alphanumeric characters (hyphens allowed in the middle); it cannot be changed after creation.
For OSPF fabrics, 'area' accepts either a dotted-quad IPv4 address (e.g. 0.0.0.0) or a plain 32-bit integer.
The 'redistribute' array is required but can be an empty array if no route redistribution is needed.
Use 'digest' to guard against concurrent writes when multiple operators may modify SDN config simultaneously.
After adding a fabric, call PUT /cluster/sdn to push the configuration to all cluster nodes; nodes will not use the new fabric until that apply step completes.
